items: `preventDefault` stops the event's normal browser action, such as a form loading a new page. Your code must provide the intended response.
`$state` marks a Svelte value as reactive so the page can follow its later changes.
A Svelte each block repeats its markup for each item. The expression in parentheses supplies the item key.

blocks.text: Each non-empty submitted title becomes a list item. The form clears after adding it.
